major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Dance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Enter Shadow Dance at low combo points when Secret Technique is ready, or during Shadow Blades; during Shadow Blades delay the second dance to the last ~8 seconds so Secret Technique fits inside, and never press it during a global cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Blades
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use with a Shadow Dance charge and Secret Technique ready so all three stack, and fit a second Shadow Dance inside the window before it ends.

major_cooldowns.name: Secret Technique
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast as your highest-priority finisher inside Shadow Dance, at 6 or more combo points, as soon as the window opens; stop finishing 3 to 4 seconds before it comes off cooldown rather than delaying Shadow Dance.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Guide lists cast id 280719; observed cast id in sampled parses is 282449.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown outside Shadow Dance at 2 or fewer combo points with at least 50 energy, and spend the stealth on Shadowstrike.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Press it just before a raid-wide hit lands; it is cheap enough to use on every area damage event.

defensives.name: Crimson Vial
defensives.usage_rule: Use as a self-heal during sustained damage or when healers are constrained.

defensives.name: Evasion
defensives.usage_rule: Use against physical damage spikes or unavoidable melee attacks.

defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Use to immune a lethal magic debuff or walk through a scripted magic hit.

rules.action: Cast Secret Technique as your first finisher inside Shadow Dance, at 6 or more combo points, as soon as the window opens. Only open Shadow Dance when Secret Technique is off cooldown.

rules.description: Shadow Blades paired with Shadow Dance
rules.action: Only send Shadow Blades when you have a Shadow Dance charge ready, and fit a second Shadow Dance inside its window once about 8 seconds of Shadow Blades remain.

rules.description: Hold Shadow Dance and Secret Technique for Shadow Blades
rules.action: When Shadow Blades is a few seconds from ready, delay Shadow Dance and Secret Technique slightly and send them all together.

rules.description: Open Shadowstrike into Shadow Dance and Shadow Blades
rules.action: Open with Shadowstrike from Stealth, then Shadow Dance, then Shadow Blades, then Secret Technique as your first finisher. Fire on-use trinkets one second ahead of Shadow Dance.
Use Vanish on cooldown at 2 or fewer combo points, outside Shadow Dance, with at least 50 energy.

rules.description: Secret Technique at 6 or more combo points
rules.action: Only cast Secret Technique at 6 or more combo points. Stop finishing 3 to 4 seconds before it comes off cooldown rather than delaying the Shadow Dance.

rules.description: Eviscerate at 6 or more combo points
rules.action: Only finish with Eviscerate at 6 or more combo points. Below that keep building.

rules.description: Black Powder at 6 or more combo points
rules.action: Only finish with Black Powder at 6 or more combo points.
Swap your finisher to Black Powder from 2 targets up. At exactly 2 targets Eviscerate is equally valid without Potent Powder, and Black Powder clearly wins from 3 targets.
Backstab is your filler on a single target only. From 2 targets up, build with Shuriken Storm instead, and with Shadowstrike while Shadow Dance is up.

rules.description: Shadowstrike over Backstab in Shadow Dance
rules.action: Shadow Dance turns Shadowstrike on, so it is your single-target builder for the whole window. Fall back to Backstab once Shadow Dance drops. Stealth and Vanish windows are excluded because they also allow Shadowstrike.

source_summary: Subtlety stacks all damage around Secret Technique: Shadow Dance is entered when Secret Technique is ready or during Shadow Blades, Shadow Blades is used with Shadow Dance, and finishers are spent at 6 or more combo points. The three cooldowns do not line up naturally, so Shadow Dance and Secret Technique are delayed slightly when Shadow Blades is about to come off cooldown. Outside those windows, single target builds with Backstab and Shadowstrike in Shadow Dance, while two or more targets switch to Shuriken Storm and Black Powder.
